commands.note: Install the signal logger: saves BTC open interest, long/short ratio, funding, DVOL and Fear&Greed every hour, and every liquidation live, into logs/signal (copied to Drive daily). Read-only public data, no orders, no bot restarted.

Install the v15 slope recorder: once a day (17:30 IST) it saves the SMA100 slope and what each shadow size rule would do, from Delta public prices only. No orders, no keys, no bot restarted, v15 untouched.
